scenicChapters.title: Great Dolomites Road
scenicChapters.narrative: For 23 km this is Great Dolomites Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Great Dolomites Road
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2239 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance. Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

great-dolomites-road.story: A 76 km one-way ride from near Bolzano, about 1 h 14 of riding. On the way it passes Carezza, Passo Costalunga, Canazei and Passo Pordoi. The highest point is about 2,250 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: The valley floor is behind you and the road starts working for its height at about 16.0%. Corners stack above one another where the ground allows nothing straighter — first and second gear more often than not. Look through each corner to the next one and let the engine do the holding.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: 1278 m come off over 20 km at around 5.3%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it. Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

appenzell-and-schwagalp-loop.story: 52 km round from Sankt Gallen - plan on about 50 min of riding. It goes by way of Appenzell, Wildhaus and Schwagalp. The highest point is about 1,300 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
